hints.title: Kruskal Baseline Weight
hints.text: Sort edges by weight and compute the baseline minimum spanning tree weight using disjoint set union.

hints.title: Critical Edge Condition
hints.text: An edge is critical if excluding it increases the minimum spanning tree weight or disconnects the graph.

hints.title: Pseudo-Critical Condition
hints.text: If an edge is not critical, force its inclusion initially. If the resulting minimum spanning tree weight equals baseline, it is pseudo-critical.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Combinatorial enumeration of all spanning trees is prohibitively exponential.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Running Kruskals algorithm E times to test exclusion and inclusion takes O(E^2 * alpha(V)), well within bounds.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate formalizes critical versus pseudo-critical criteria using forced inclusion and exclusion runs of Kruskals.
complexity.notes: Can also be solved in O(E log E) using Tarjans bridge finding on equal-weight edge blocks.
